verdict.rationale: Smooth's core offering is natural-language task execution. A one-line `run("Go to google flights and find the cheapest flight...")` hands the agent a goal (smooth-docs-13, smooth-docs-1), and the docs explicitly cover navigating complex multi-step forms, dropdowns, checkboxes and submission (smooth-docs-31) plus multi-step session workflows across pages (smooth-docs-14, smooth-docs-34). A community user reports a complex prompt executed well (smooth-comm-2). Missing for 10: independent, reproducible hands-on evidence of complex form/flow completion beyond one brief anecdote; commenters also asked for public evals.
